decisions_settled.D5: Invariant guard split (ratified): code diad byte-frozen against 7 reference commits; bilingual_registry.json guarded by monotonic growth vs 38beb35 (no doctype/key removal, search.fields only a superset, state never regressing, top-level blocks unchanged). decisions_settled.F1: A new master needs three registrations: (1) Arabic/norm custom fields via patch v9_11, (2) bilingual registry entry, (3) hooks.py doc_events validate hook (enforce_bilingual_arabic_policy + narrative_sanitizer where a narrative field exists). Without (3) norm derivation and BIDI rejection do not fire - pilot run 1 failed 4/8 for this reason.

latency_measurement.methodology: 5 rounds x n=100 interleaved, min-of-rounds nearest-rank P95, 5 warmups per round
latency_measurement.disclosure: Preliminary run (evidence/brand-p95-run.log) returned 1.5066, 0.44% above the Tier 2B band while still under the 1.50 ms universal ceiling; retained rather than discarded. Confirmation run 5 first attempt aborted with QueueOverloaded (600 queued jobs from harness insert/delete cycles); queue flushed and retry succeeded - both are in evidence/brand-p95-confirm.log. Match-set equivalence and zero leftover fixtures held on every successful run.
